svg.title: Costa surface: a linearized ancient time sequence
svg.desc: Four views of a sampled genus-one Costa surface with three open ends, displaced along a positive numerical Dirichlet Jacobi mode. Displacement is magnified three times. Not nonlinear ancient flow slices.

g.text: Leaving the Costa surface · forward in model time
Numerical linearized model · positive side · displacement ×3 · same spatial scale
As τ → −∞, both signs return to the same stationary Costa surface.
X ± 0.11 exp(τ) φν, τ = λt. The screen magnifies the normal displacement, not time.
Mramor–Payne, Theorem 1.1 and §3. Costa geometry: Melko (2010), eq. (17). Ends truncated.
